# Project X — Digikala Business (DKB) product knowledge and design system

> Context for AI agents that design DKB products (B2R retailers, B2E company procurement, Enterprise Portals) in Figma with the DKB Design System. Persian, right-to-left, Jalali dates, toman. Start with AGENTS.md.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what to read, hard rules for designs, the design-task workflow, how to change the design system, Figma lessons
- [Component index](design-system/components/INDEX.md): every DKB component and what it is for
- [Token reference](design-system/build/token-reference.md): every usable token, its value per brand and screen, and its use

## Design system
- [Design system README](design-system/README.md): principles, token and component architecture, naming, build and Figma sync
- [components.json](design-system/components.json): component API — library keys, variants, property ids, defaults
- [Component specs](design-system/components/): one file per component (purpose, anatomy, properties, tokens, states, RTL, accessibility, content)
- [figma-library-keys.json](design-system/figma-library-keys.json): library keys of published variables and styles
- [Agent helpers](design-system/scripts/figma/agent-helpers.js): prelude for use_figma scripts with every library key built in
- [Design audit](design-system/scripts/figma/audit-design.js): checks a design page for unbound colours, unstyled text and non-library instances
- [Decisions](design-system/DECISIONS.md), [Changelog](design-system/CHANGELOG.md), [shadcn coverage](design-system/COVERAGE.md)
- [Tokens](design-system/tokens/): DTCG JSON source of truth; [build outputs](design-system/build/): CSS, Tailwind theme, shadcn mapping, contrast report

## Product knowledge
- [B2E foundation](knowledge-base/b2e-foundation-knowledge-base.md): company procurement; also the layers shared with B2R and Portals (roles, rules, statuses, IA, flows, principles, glossary, gaps)
- [B2R foundation](knowledge-base/b2r-foundation-knowledge-base.md): retailers
- [Portals foundation](knowledge-base/portals-foundation-knowledge-base.md): enterprise portal tenants
- [Research insights](research/research-insights-drive.md): interviews, heuristic evaluation, tests, CSAT

## Designs
- [Design specs](designs/README.md): one spec per design task, from [the template](designs/_template.md); example: [B2E address edit](designs/b2e-address-edit.md)

## Optional
- [Raw findings](raw-findings/): source notes behind the foundation docs; read only when a detail is missing
- [Typography foundations](design-system/foundations/typography.md): font facts and OpenType features
